_comment: JPL Horizons answers for test_horizons_check.py (L-395), keyed by the exact query the check makes. Answers from 2026-10-07 were fetched by Tony in his browser and recorded in the orrery's documentation/HORIZONS_ANSWERS_L395_20261007.md. Answers from 2026-10-10 were fetched by this build session through the chat's web-fetch tool, which passes a page through a reading model: their field lines are JPL's, their layout is rebuilt. Each answer's source is in sources. Re-fetched 2026-10-10: every 2026-10-07 answer used here read the same except Encke's record (G3), which JPL re-solved in place (solution date 2026-Oct-09); the recorded 2026-10-07 text is kept. Moved from the gallery's documentation/ into the orrery's documentation/worksheets/ by L-431 build 3 (2026-10-14), with the check. That build added answers for the period's elements queries and the spacecraft data sheets; every one it added is CONSTRUCTED, says so in sources, and is not JPL's text.

inputs._comment: What test_horizons_check.py runs the check on, frozen with these answers on 2026-10-14 (L-431 build 3), so the test does not move when the live records do: the orbit cache's entries for Mercury, Jupiter and Encke as they stood at orrery db63721d (their period records' dates are the dates the recorded elements answers were asked at); the thirteen identity confirmations as the move carried them over, before any period was confirmed; and the 26 data sheets as seeded from the survey of 2026-10-12. The live files, data/osculating_cache.json, data/horizons_confirmations.json and data/spacecraft_sheets.json, change on every plot and every check; this copy never does.

confirmations._comment: Written by horizons_check.py (L-395, L-431): the last date each keyed entry of the orrery's object list was confirmed against JPL Horizons, and what was confirmed -- its identity, and its period where the period was fetched -- with this record's last run. Only the check writes it. check_horizons_confirmations.py reads it offline, and export_objects.py copies its dates into data/objects_export.json. The identity confirmations of 2026-10-10 were carried over from the website's own record by L-431's build 3. Do not edit by hand.
